_comment: Source for the VERSIONINFO resource shown in the .exe Properties dialog
and in Task Manager's Details tab. Compiled into nimbus_windows_amd64.syso
FileVersion and ProductVersion are left empty here on purpose: the
generator fills them from -version, which the Makefile feeds from the
same `git describe` value that -ldflags injects into internal/build.
Hard-coding a version here would let the two drift apart.
CharsetID 04B0 = 1200 = Unicode; the version resource carries one string
table and it is the English one, unlike the runtime UI which is
translated. A second, Ukrainian table would need a resource compiler that
supports multiple string tables - goversioninfo does not.
